description: NaCl Bader analysis with -b weight. Exact Decimal values are derived from the printed ACF CHARGE tokens; eight decimal places do not imply physical accuracy. Paths refer to published repository files; generated filenames identify analysis intermediates.
definition: Na_transfer = zval_Na - mean(CHARGE[Na]); Cl_gain = mean(CHARGE[Cl]) - 7. Atoms 1-4 Na, 5-8 Cl. Reference partitions only; primary valence density integrated.

path_figures.description: Charge-density figures independent of the Bader partition algorithm; each density series contains 19 actual grid points.

plotting.notes: Original path values and radial table rows are preserved; no interpolation or density gradients are computed. Construction-radius annotations list frozen-core and occupied-valence configurations, plus zero-occupancy scattering reference states. Underlined subshells belong to the frozen core. Solid leaders indicate channels that contribute to the core density; dashed leaders indicate channels that do not.
